Spot 1h klines (monthly zips) 2018-07..2026-09 UTC; USDT-M perp 1d klines and perp fundingRate history (monthly zips). Daily bar = 00:00-23:59 UTC built from 1h; daily close = close of the 23:00 bar; r_t = close_t/close_(t-1)-1. CANDIDATES (fixed now, chosen to include coins that later collapsed or were delisted, to limit survivorship): BTC ETH BNB XRP ADA SOL DOGE DOT LTC LINK BCH TRX AVAX MATIC POL ATOM ETC XLM EOS FIL UNI NEAR AAVE ALGO VET ICP SHIB APT ARB OP SUI LUNA FTT WAVES XMR NEO IOTA ZEC DASH XTZ SAND MANA AXS FTM APE GALA CHZ CRV INJ TON PEPE WIF HBAR THETA EGLD (all vs USDT; perp symbol for SHIB/PEPE = 1000SHIB/1000PEPE, price-scaled; a symbol absent on data.binance.vision is skipped and logged). UNIVERSE U_m: on the first day of each month, the 25 candidates with the highest USDT quote volume over the previous 30 days among those with >=180 days of prior data and a bar on the last day of the previous month; a coin whose data stop mid-month is closed at its last close. TIMING: weights for day t+1 use data through the 23:00 bar close of day t only; P&L_(t+1) = sum w_i*r_i,(t+1) - cost*sum|w_i,(t+1)-w_i,t(drifted)| - funding. FUNDING: a perp position of weight w pays w*f for each funding print f in the day (long pays positive f); before a symbol has funding history, assume f = 0.0001 per 8h. COST per side per unit notional traded: perp 5 bp taker + 2 bp spread/slippage = 7 bp; spot leg 7.5 bp + 2 bp = 9.5 bp. COST x2 = double all. VOL: sigma_i = 60-day rolling std of daily r, x sqrt(365). PERIODS: in-sample IS = 2019-01-01..2022-12-31 (used only for D3-09 hour selection and for the fixed scale factor below; reported); OUT-OF-SAMPLE OOS = 2023-01-01..2026-09-30 (never used to choose any rule). hypothesis: PRE-REGISTERED MODEL (economics, not an edge test): per-firm prop economics at given Sharpe with firm-optimal vol. Model = copy of scripts/apex_model.py extended in agents/daily/w1-prop/prop_model.py. Strategy return per trading day (252/yr) = mu+s*e, e = Student-t(5) scaled to unit variance, mu = S*sigma/252, s = sigma/sqrt(252); each day split into 4 equal sub-steps (each t5 noise, same total moments) so intraday trailing drawdown and daily loss limits see an intraday path. S is the strategy's annual Sharpe NET of trading costs (spread+commission+swap/funding), dollar risk fixed on the starting balance (no compounding). sigma = annual vol as % of starting balance, chosen per firm and per S from the grid {1,2,3,4,5,6,8,10,12,15,20,25,30,40}% separately for the evaluation (sigma_e) and the funded phase (sigma_f), maximizing mean pre-tax net dollars per slot-year. Economics by renewal-reward: one slot = buy evaluation, run until pass / breach / expiry, rebuy on fail; on pass pay activation fee (if any) and run the funded account until breach, firm-imposed closure (max payouts) or a 3-year horizon, then rebuy. Rate per slot-year = E[cycle reward]/E[cycle length]; reward = trader share of payouts + refunds - all fees (eval, rebuys, activation, monthly subscriptions while in evaluation, data/API fees). Payouts: at each firm payout date the trader withdraws the firm's maximum allowed (min of cap and the allowed fraction of profit above the payout floor) if it is >= the firm minimum; trader keeps split. Consistency rules and news/one-sided-bet rules are NOT modeled (noted per firm). Firm parameters are taken mechanically from agents/daily/w1-prop/rules.csv (the verified rules table) for one standard program per firm; any value marked unverified is used but flagged. Outputs per firm x S in {0.8,1.0,1.2,1.5,2.0} (and 1.17): pass probability per attempt, mean funded lifetime (trading days), mean payouts per funded account, fees per slot-year, ROS = (payouts - fees)/fees per year after 25% tax on positive net (the >=20% test uses after-tax ROS), and fleet dollars/yr = slots at the per-person max x per-slot rate (fleet copies one strategy, so accounts are perfectly correlated; fleet p10 = slots x per-slot p10). Min Sharpe for ROS>=20% found by bisection on S in [0.3,3.0]. n = 4000 paths per (firm, S, sigma), seed 11. Not a test of any market edge: no market data is used, so no out-of-sample split applies; the gate t>=3.5504 does not apply to these rows.
